Monster drop: Thak Footman

What it does

Less damage from elite and boss monsters: 4%. Goes on an armor piece. All your armor together stops at 12%. Lasts 500 kills that pay you XP.

Dropped by monsters of level 49 and up. About augments. Placeholder: which monsters give which kind is still unknown.
